name: MyPost2 – Evergreen Content Strategy, Social Media & SEO Shortlinks
author: sevenbirds

sections.description:
MyPost2 is a comprehensive content recycling platform that helps bloggers and content creators maximize the value of their existing content as part of a robust content strategy while maintaining SEO best practices.

Key Features:

  • Maturation Tracking – Default 21-day rule or customize your own waiting period before republishing
  • SEO Protection – Comprehensive safeguards including noindex, canonical URLs, sitemap exclusions, and more
  • Advanced Analytics – Track performance with built-in bot detection and detailed visitor insights
  • Shortlink Generation – Shortlink generation and redirects (get.mypost.to/slug URLs)
  • Fediverse Integration – Boost your content on Mastodon, Bluesky, and Flipboard Social
  • Multi-Domain Support – Manage up to 20 domains from a single installation
  • Pay-Per-Use Pricing – No monthly subscriptions – buy darts and pay only for what you create

Perfect For:

  • Bloggers who want to safely republish evergreen content
  • Content creators looking to maximize content ROI
  • Sites wanting to avoid duplicate content penalties
  • Publishers who prefer pay-as-you-go over recurring fees

How It Works:

  1. Add posts to your repost pool when they’re ready for recycling
  2. Create reposts with custom titles, featured images, adjust article content to your strategy
  3. MyPost2 handles all SEO protection automatically
  4. Track performance with built-in analytics
  5. Optionally boost on Fediverse social platforms
  6. Use shortlinks for easy sharing

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its core functionality. These services are required for reposting, analytics, shortlink creation, and regional usage statistics.

MyPost2 API Service (https://get.mypost.to)

The plugin connects to the MyPost2 API service to deliver its main features.

What the service is used for:

  • Domain authentication and verification
  • Dart balance management and transactions
  • Repost creation and scheduling
  • Shortlink generation (get.mypost.to URLs)
  • Fediverse boost distribution
  • Aggregated analytics data processing

What data is sent and when:

  • Domain name and email address during plugin activation and authentication
  • Post titles, images URL and reposts URLs when creating shortlinks or reposts
  • Hashtags and post descriptions for Fediverse boosts
  • Aggregated analytics data during normal plugin usage

A free MyPost2 account is required and is created automatically during plugin setup after acceptance of the terms.

Privacy & Terms:

  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service
  • Refund Policy

All data is transmitted securely using HTTPS/TLS. No personal data is sold to third parties.

IP Geolocation Service (ipapi.co)

The plugin connects to the ipapi.co service to determine the country associated with an IP address for anonymous analytics and usage statistics.

What the service is used for:

  • Converting IP addresses into country-level location data for aggregated analytics reporting

What data is sent and when:

  • An IP address is sent to ipapi.co over HTTPS when analytics data is processed
  • Only the country name is retrieved
  • The IP address is not stored by the plugin after the lookup

This service is used solely for anonymous, country-based statistics.

Service Provider:

  • ipapi.co

Privacy & Compliance:

  • Privacy Policy
  • The service states compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and VCDPA regulations

User Dashboard (https://dashboard.mypost.to)

Users have access to the MyPost2 dashboard to manage their account.

Dashboard features include:

  • Viewing detailed analytics and reports
  • Managing Fediverse social media actions
  • Purchasing darts and managing billing
  • Configuring account settings

Privacy Policy

MyPost2 takes privacy seriously:

  • Visitors IP addresses converted to anonymous country IDs before storage
  • Session cookies are necessary to access to dashboard
  • No tracking cookies are used
  • Analytics data is anonymous; Ip addresses are converted to country-level identifiers only
  • No personal data is sold to third parties
  • GDPR compliant
  • Full privacy policy

Support

  • Support: https://mypost.to/support
  • Email: info@mypost.to

Credits

MyPost2 includes one filee adapted from:
– NJT Duplicate plugin for WordPress compatibility

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

The MyPost2 API service is proprietary and requires a separate service agreement.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “MyPost2”
  4. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  5. Go to MyPost2 > Setup to connect your account

Manual Installation:

  1. Upload the unzipped mypost2 folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to MyPost2 > Setup to connect your account

First-Time Setup:

  1. Navigate to MyPost2 > Setup
  2. Enter your email address
  3. Check your email for verification
  4. Complete verification to activate your domain
  5. Enjoy your 10 free included Darts on activation of a new account
  6. Purchase additional darts when needed (linked from dashboard)
  7. Start adding posts to your repost pool!
  8. Create reposts and boost them on the Fediverse if you wish to do so.
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay to use this plugin?

The plugin is free to install and use. However, creating reposts requires “darts” (pay-per-use credits). Basic features like adding posts to your pool and viewing analytics work without payment. New accounts receive 10 free darts for testing purposes.

What are darts?

Darts are pay-per-use credits. Creating a repost (either on your domain or as a shortlink) costs 2 darts. Adding a Fediverse social boost costs an additional 1 dart. This means no monthly subscription – you only pay for what you create. Visit https://mypost.to/ for more details.

How does the 21-day rule work?

The 21-day maturation period ensures your original content has time to have its own life before republishing and avoid spamming. You can customize this period in the plugin settings.

Will this harm my SEO?

MyPost2 includes comprehensive SEO protection:

  • Canonical URLs point to original content
  • Noindex tags on reposts
  • Sitemap and RSS exclusions
  • WordPress features exclusion (navigation, related posts, etc…)
  • Search engine blocking
    This ensures search engines recognize the original as the primary source.

Can I use my own domain for reposts?

Yes! By default, reposts are created on your WordPress site. You can optionally use MyPost.to shortlinks instead or in addition.

What is Fediverse integration?

The Fediverse is a network of decentralized social platforms (Mastodon, Bluesky, Flipboard Social). MyPost2 can automatically share your reposts to these networks with custom hashtags.

Is my data private?

Yes. IP addresses converted to anonymous country IDs before storage (GDPR compliant), and we don’t sell data to third parties. See our privacy policy at https://mypost.to/privacy-policy/

Can I get a refund on unused darts?

Darts don’t expire and can be used anytime. We don’t offer refunds on dart purchases, but you can always use them for future reposts.
Refund policy available at: https://mypost.to/refund-policy/

Do I need technical knowledge?

No! MyPost2 is designed for non-technical users. The interface is intuitive, and setup takes just a few minutes.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your reposts remain on your site as regular WordPress posts. However, you’ll lose access to MyPost2’s SEO protection and analytics features.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

IMPORTANT: Deleting (not just deactivating) MyPost2 will permanently remove:
– All reposts and their analytics data
– All shortlinks and tracking data
– All billing transaction history
– All plugin settings

This action CANNOT be undone. If you only want to temporarily disable the plugin, use “Deactivate” instead of “Delete”.

Your SaaS account at Dashboard.MyPost.to will remain active and can be used with other WordPress sites.
